requirement_match.summary: Approved frontend scope implemented with four KPI cards, labeled queue bars, five action rows, UTC presets/custom range and auto-load. Monetary/trend metrics intentionally unavailable.

security.summary: Existing authenticated callable and staff checks retained; no backend, writes, PII, secrets or dependency edits. Permission denial clears old private counts; unmount invalidates async ownership.

code_quality.summary: TypeScript and scoped ESLint passed; deterministic typed helpers, bounded metrics, isolated CSS, no new dependency; shared WIP preserved.

failure_paths.summary: Invalid/31-day dates, unavailable/zero/partial, stale retry, malformed response, permission, concurrency and unmount exercised. UTC-midnight zero-duration input rejected before call.

error_handling.summary: Review found empty-state scope ambiguity; fix and verify before handoff.

production_readiness.summary: Readiness assessed: local implementation validated; production NOT_READY. No build artifact, deployment, provider or global shared-worktree release certification. Rollback reverts scoped frontend files only.

trade_offs.summary: Counts retain existing UTC cap/overlapping semantics. No sums, funnel or invented financial metrics; destination filters differ and are disclosed. Charts use CSS and textual values without a library.

findings.summary: Earlier empty message could imply no work in the whole date range even when the query hit the cap.
Failed new range needed explicit request-period feedback alongside retained previous data period.
findings.resolution: Failure status now names requested period; data label remains last successful applied range; browser retry test passed.

findings.summary: Preset labels wrapped into two lines next to refresh on narrow mobile.
findings.resolution: Preset group takes a full row and controls use minimum 44px; mobile screenshots checked.

residual_risks: Bounded 100-record current-state sample is not global BI or revenue.
Known Vite fixture HMR local-network warnings excluded from app console assertion; underlying app behavior checked through actual emulator too.
Shared unrelated WIP may change global runtime signatures after review.
limitations: CocoIndex freshness degraded; approval script hard-codes READY despite allowed degraded policy.
No production deployment/provider, other browser engine or real screen-reader evidence.
Full artifact build not run; actual Vite modules and TypeScript compiled.
